source.title: Northern Whig, 4 May 1939, p. 10 ("Belfast and Castlereagh Rural Councils")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Nominations from the Northern Whig (4 May 1939, p. 10) and Belfast Telegraph (4 May 1939, p. 4).

note: Triennial election, polled at the end of May 1939. Eight divisions were filled by nomination without a contest; Ballyhackamore had no nomination and its retiring member was to be deemed re-elected on completing the necessary forms. Filed on 1939-06-01, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1939-05-31 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
